The '''Kashyyykian ceremonial armor''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] used by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:P7" /> Although the Wookiees were capable of using advanced technology, this armor was built using natural resources from their homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. As its name suggested, it was mainly used in formal ceremonies but had some protective value as well. This model of armor combined an emphasis on organic components with sturdy functionality that allowed the Wookiees to combat dangerous creatures.<ref name="WA">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Wookiee%20Armor|text=Wookiee Armor}}</ref> The Kashyyykian ceremonial armor offered a high degree of protection against energy-based weapons like [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] but lesser protection from kinetic damage.<ref name="SWG:CU" /> The complete armor set comprised a chest plate with an included helmet, left & right biceps, left & right bracers and leggings.<ref name="SWG:P7" />

Two other models of Wookiee armors were the Kashyyykian [[Kashyyykian black mountain armor|black mountain]] and [[Kashyyykian hunting armor|hunting]] armors.<ref name="SWG:P9.2">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Publish 9.2}}</ref>

Kashyyykian ceremonial armors were worn by the [[Rryatt Ceremonial Guard]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kashyyykian ceremonial armor appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:P7" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Kashyyykian ceremonial armor was added to the game with an [[W:c:swg:Update Notes: 30 March 04|update]] released on [[March 30]], [[2004]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 7: Droid Invasion">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=61441|text=Publish 7: Droid Invasion}}</ref>
